title: E-QTM-0072: zitterbewegung from the coined Dirac walk model: a massive walk's chirality trembles at exactly twice...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0072 in the quantum arena: zitterbewegung from the coined Dirac walk model: a massive walk's chirality trembles at exactly twice the mass (the frequency measured off the walk is within three percent of 2 mass at every mass and doubles when the mass doubles), while a massless walk does not tremble at all.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
